Market today: Tech is getting hammered, and it's not just a little dip. The headlines about widespread tech failures and national security comms issues are spooking everyone, especially with your concentrated book.

Your holdings: Most of your leveraged tech ETFs are bleeding badly. SMCI is down nearly 46%, SOXL is down almost 80%. Your leveraged MU and PLTR ETFs are also deep in the red. CRWD is your only green name at +25%, but it's marked TRIM. SPY and QQQ are also SELL signals.

Watch: Keep an eye on the broader market sentiment and any further news on tech infrastructure problems. Your leveraged ETFs are particularly vulnerable to any continued sell-off.

Bottom line: Your concentrated, leveraged tech book is facing significant headwinds. Focus on managing risk and protecting capital.
plays: Consider trimming SPAL and MUU further given their deep losses and leveraged nature.
Respect the stop on CRWD at 147.5, but consider if the current strength warrants holding.
No new buys today - hold and watch
